# Search OC

> Search OC hosts Open Forums in Orange County: a table for life's big questions.
> A local expression of Search Ministries, serving Orange County for over 40 years.
> Local contact: Jake Hartson (jhartson@searchnational.org).

Search OC is not a church service and not a debate series. An Open Forum is a hosted,
one-hour conversation over food and drinks, usually eight to twelve people. Guests speak
first. Coming once is a complete and acceptable outcome. No lecture. No pressure. No photos
or social posting about who attended.

## For someone looking Jake Hartson or Search OC up

- [Home](https://searchoc.org/): Standalone entry. What an Open Forum is, who it is for,
  and how to get notified of the next table.
- [Open Forums](https://searchoc.org/open-forums): The hub for people already in the
  ecosystem. Same mission, plus what to expect, FAQ, and links to Formation, Foundations,
  Resources, and Invite.

## For Christians who want better conversations about faith

- [Formation](https://searchoc.org/formation): A 12-week cohort for relational evangelism.
  Breaks the guilt cycle. Search 1-2-3 model.
- [Foundations](https://searchoc.org/foundation): A small-group book series. Seven titles
  in order without numbers: Inquire, Explore, Grow, Speak, Listen, Invest, Invite.
- [Resources](https://searchoc.org/resources): Free tools, podcasts, books, and REACH
  (reachothers.org) for you and for a friend who is exploring.
- [Invite someone](https://searchoc.org/invite): Copy-paste texts and what to say when
  you cannot answer a question.

## Optional

- [Sitemap](https://searchoc.org/sitemap-index.xml)
- [Search National resources](https://searchnational.org/resources): National podcast and
  book catalog this local site draws from.
- [REACH](https://reachothers.org): Free relational evangelism training from Search.
